product_one_liner.value: Talowiz is an AI-powered source-to-hire platform for talent-acquisition teams that autonomously sources, evaluates, interviews, and selects candidates to automate recruiting workflows.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn reports 15 employees, which falls in this band.

hq_location.notes: The company site gives a San Jose office address and PitchBook/Tracxn identify San Jose; LinkedIn also has an Ashburn location listing.

founded_year.notes: Talowiz’s LinkedIn company profile and Tracxn list 2022; PitchBook lists 2021, so public sources conflict.

eng_blog.notes: The index shows recruiting/product and hiring-advice articles rather than at least two engineering-authored posts explaining how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: The homepage/footer links to pricing, blog, terms, and privacy but not product documentation or a help center.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers listing says there were no open roles as of November 9, 2026.

model_provider.value: Talowiz says it developed a custom AI model for personalizing behavior and content; it does not name an external model provider.
model_provider.notes: The statement specifically describes its AI training model for user-persona personalization, not a named foundation-model vendor.

compliance_certs.notes: The post names SOC2 and GDPR/DPDP features and says ISO/SOC-compliant, but does not specify ISO 27001.

last_funding.notes: PitchBook labels the latest deal Early Stage VC and lists one investor; the accessible funding records do not disclose a date or amount.

raised_18mo.notes: Funding sources indicate a VC deal but do not expose its date, so whether it fell between May 9, 2025 and November 9, 2026 cannot be established.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers listing says there were no open roles as of November 9, 2026.

launched_6mo.notes: The readable blog index’s latest listed post is dated March 6, 2026, before the May 9–November 9 window; no dated product or major-feature launch announcement in the window was found.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The small roster shows Dheeraj Lal as cofounder for about four years and Aparna Rajkhowa as an employee; Shubhanshu Srivastava’s profile lists him as Founder/CEO since November 2021. No C-level/VP join or departure in the window was found.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The privacy policy identifies Google Analytics for website traffic and Mailchimp for newsletters and transactional emails.
